1.title: Exam Orientation and How to Study
1.text: Welcome to Module zero: Exam Orientation and How to Study. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do six things. The exam at a glance. The three domains. The platform in one picture. How to answer every question. A study plan. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Scope: Exam overview, domain map and answer technique (all domains). Exam format: one hundred minutes; a score of seven hundred on a scale of one to one thousand passes. Validated against: the official Microsoft S C-two hundred study guide and Microsoft Learn.

1.title: The exam at a glance
1.text: The exam at a glance. Exam. S C-two hundred: Microsoft Security Operations Analyst. Skills list in force. Skills measured as of October twenty-one, twenty twenty-six (only the data ingestion area changed, a minor edit). Time. one hundred minutes. Passing score. seven hundred on a scale of one to one thousand. Level and role. Intermediate; Security Operations Analyst. Delivery. Proctored; the exam may include interactive components. Languages. English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Italian.

1.title: The exam at a glance, continued
1.text: The exam at a glance. Renewal. The credential is valid for twelve months; you renew it with a free online assessment. Retake. You can retake twenty-four hours after a first failed attempt; later waits are longer.

1.title: The exam at a glance, continued
1.text: The exam at a glance. The number of questions and the price are not published on the study guide, so this course does not quote them. Price depends on the country where you sit the exam. Exam tip: The seven hundred passing score is a scaled score, not seventy percent of the questions. Do not try to calculate how many questions you may miss; answer every question, because a blank earns nothing.

1.title: The three domains
1.text: The three domains. The figure shows this: Domain map: three domains, nine skill areas and the modules that cover them.

1.title: The three domains, continued
1.text: The three domains. one. Manage a security operations environment. Weight: forty to forty-five percent. Skill areas: Configure automation for Defender X D R and Sentinel; configure the Sentinel sim and platform; ingest data; configure detections. two. Respond to security incidents. Weight: thirty-five to forty percent. Skill areas: Respond in Defender X D R; respond in Defender for Endpoint; investigate Microsoft three sixty-five activities. three. Perform threat hunting. Weight: twenty to twenty-five percent. Skill areas: Detect threats by using Defender X D R; detect threats by using the Sentinel platform. Exam tip: Domain one is the largest. It is about configuring: settings, portal paths, roles, connectors and rules. Learn where a setting lives and which role is needed, not only what the feature does.

1.title: The platform in one picture
1.text: The platform in one picture. The exam treats the Microsoft Defender portal as the single place where a security operations analyst works. Microsoft Sentinel (the sim) and Microsoft Defender X D R (the extended detection and response suite) meet there. Defender for Endpoint. What it protects or does: Devices (Windows, mac O S, Linux). Sends to the incident queue: Device alerts. Defender for Office three sixty-five. What it protects or does: Email and collaboration. Sends to the incident queue: Phishing and malware alerts. Defender for Identity. What it protects or does: On-premises Active Directory identities. Sends to the incident queue: Identity attack alerts. Defender for Cloud Apps. What it protects or does: sass apps and oh auth apps. Sends to the incident queue: App and session alerts.

1.title: The platform in one picture, continued
1.text: The platform in one picture. Entra I D Protection. What it protects or does: Cloud identities. Sends to the incident queue: Risky user and sign-in alerts. Defender for Cloud. What it protects or does: Azure and multicloud workloads. Sends to the incident queue: Workload alerts. Microsoft Purview. What it protects or does: Insider risk and data protection. Sends to the incident queue: Compromised entity alerts. Microsoft Sentinel. What it protects or does: sim: collects any log, detects, hunts, automates. Sends to the incident queue: Sentinel alerts and incidents. Microsoft Sentinel in the Azure portal ends on March thirty-one, twenty twenty-seven. After that date it is supported only in the Defender portal. The exam asks for Defender portal paths.

1.title: How to answer every question
1.text: How to answer every question. Read the last line first to see what is asked: a setting, a role, a tool or a next step. Find the product the scenario points to: device, email, identity, cloud app, cloud workload or log source. Eliminate options from the wrong product or the wrong portal. Prefer the least-privileged role and the least effort that meets every stated requirement. For K Q L questions, read the table name and the operator first; the table tells you the data source. Exam tip: When two answers both work, the exam wants the one that meets all the requirements with the least administrative effort: an automation rule rather than a manual step, a built-in role rather than a custom one.

1.title: A study plan
1.text: A study plan. one. Modules: one to four. Goal: Defender X D R and Defender for Endpoint configuration. two. Modules: five to eight. Goal: Sentinel automation, platform and data ingestion. three. Modules: nine to ten. Goal: Detections: custom rules and analytics rules. four. Modules: eleven to fourteen. Goal: Incident response and Microsoft three sixty-five investigations. five. Modules: fifteen to seventeen. Goal: K Q L and threat hunting. six. Modules: eighteen. Goal: Exam technique and final review.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. A candidate studies for S C-two hundred and wants to know which domain carries the most weight. Which domain is it? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Manage a security operations environment, with the highest percentage range. Domain one, managing a security operations environment, carries forty to forty-five percent.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. A candidate reads that the exam passing score is seven hundred. A colleague says this means seventy percent of the questions must be correct. What is the correct view? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: The score is scaled from one to one thousand, so it is not a plain percentage. S C-two hundred reports a scaled score from one to one thousand; seven hundred or more passes.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. An analyst must pick the portal path for working with Microsoft Sentinel after March thirty-one, twenty twenty-seven. Which portal will support it? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Only the Microsoft Defender portal, because Azure portal support ends. After March thirty-one, twenty twenty-seven, Microsoft Sentinel is supported only in the Defender portal.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. A question describes phishing email that reached many mailboxes and asks which product to open first. Which product fits the scenario? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Defender for Office three sixty-five, because the data source is email. Email and collaboration threats belong to Defender for Office three sixty-five.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. A candidate fails S C-two hundred on the first attempt and wants to try again quickly. What is the earliest retake? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: After twenty-four hours following the first failed attempt. A first retake is allowed after twenty-four hours; later retakes wait longer.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. A candidate has the S C-two hundred credential and receives a renewal notice. How is the credential renewed? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: By passing a free online renewal assessment within the window. The credential renews every twelve months with a free online assessment.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. How long is the S C-two hundred exam? Answer: one hundred minutes. Question two. What is the passing score? Answer: seven hundred on a scale of one to one thousand. Question three. Name the three domains. Answer: Manage a security operations environment, respond to security incidents, perform threat hunting.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. What is the weight of threat hunting? Answer: twenty to twenty-five percent. Question five. When does Microsoft Sentinel stop being supported in the Azure portal? Answer: After March thirty-one, twenty twenty-seven. Question six. How often does the credential need renewal? Answer: Every twelve months, with a free online assessment.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Format: one hundred minutes, seven hundred of one thousand, proctored, may include interactive components. Weights: forty to forty-five or thirty-five to forty or twenty to twenty-five percent. Skills list: as of October twenty-one, twenty twenty-six. Portal: Defender portal; Sentinel leaves the Azure portal after March thirty-one, twenty twenty-seven. Method: find the product, eliminate the wrong portal, pick the least privilege and least effort. Renewal: twelve months, free online assessment. If this course is helping you, please subscribe to the channel and hit the bell icon, so you get a notification when the next video is out. In the next module, we continue the course.
